generations.prompt: A weathered detective in his 40s with a rumpled trench coat and loosened tie stands in deep shadow, filmed in extreme close-up focusing on his face. The camera holds steady on his features as harsh side lighting creates a stark division between light and shadow across his face. His jaw visibly tightens, the muscles flexing beneath weathered skin. As he processes a dark realization, a shadow slowly creeps across his eyes from above, plunging them into darkness while leaving his clenched jaw partially illuminated. He speaks with grim finality, his voice low and ominous: "Neither do I." The background is completely underexposed to black, with only a cold blue rim light outlining his silhouette. The lighting emphasizes every line and crease in his face, creating a noir-style portrait of a man making a fateful decision. Shot on 9:16 vertical format with shallow depth of field, the focus remains razor-sharp on his tightening expression as darkness literally and metaphorically overtakes him.
